blend.note: NOT backbone+overlay - a single fused tongue, as if Plains and Steppe descended from one trans-Beringian ancestor. Models the real Dene-Yeniseian hypothesis (Vajda) linking Na-Dene/Apache to Siberian Yeniseian, plus the demographic Beringian migration. Roots, titles and theonyms are blended forms sitting between the two parents (agglutinative, vowel-harmonic, open CV).

_note: Cross-family DEEP BLEND (Plains horse-nomads + Steppe horse-nomads): a single people whose tongue reads like the common ancestor of both - mounted herders of grassland and savanna who share the steppe's hordes-and-khans and the plains' bands-and-vision-quests. Not backbone+overlay: the lexicon, titles and deity-names are genuinely fused forms. clan = clanhold. Seeds/shifts Neutral or Chaotic. Common-word lexicon and rank titles fuse the real Plains (Comanche-leaning) and Mongol-Turkic registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are fused morphs of the Agrippan canon (sitting between the Plains and Steppe sets), never real gods.

phonology.palette: Fused Plains-Steppe: open CV syllables; vowel harmony (back a/o/u vs front e/i); consonants p t k s sh h m n w y, kh, ng, glottal stop '; agglutinative suffixes shared by both parents (-tai/-ta, -na, -ai); the fused theonym/lexicon roots sit between Comanche and Mongol forms.
phonology.phonotactics: CV/CVC; open vowels; vowel harmony; agglutination; glottal stops.

morphology.patronymic_form: father's name + -in/-tu; the ovonu (band-clan, named for an animal or food); a deed- or vision-name earned at coming-of-age; the honor Baatu (hero).
morphology.compounding_rule: [quality|animal](stem) + feature: Kara-toyul (black-mountain), Kutsa-talso (bison-plain); the horde/band named for its khan or its food; -ordu for the moving camp.

title_ladder.government: clanhold (a fusion of plains bands and steppe hordes: the ovonu-clans and their khans, the war-societies and the vision-chiefs; the khural-council raises the head-khan; the camp moves with the herds)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Fused Plains-Steppe clanhold, ascending; the titles are blended forms (plains nantan/paraibo/naika + steppe noyan/khan/khagan). Noytan (band-lord) barony; Tarkwan (border war-warden) march; Paranoy (band-chief) county; Mingbo (thousand war-chief) duchy; Bekibo (great chief of several bands) principality; Naikhan (head-khan) kingdom; Khanaika (grand head-khan) empire over the Karak-Ulus (the great-nation). The khural-council and the war-societies check the khans. (Rank titles fuse the real Plains/Mongol registers, allowed.)

people_name_convention.order: a child-name, replaced at coming-of-age by a deed- or vision-name; the ovonu (band-clan); an animal+quality byname or the honor Baatu.
people_name_convention.dual_register: khans and braves bear deed-names and society-honors; others a band-name + given name.
people_name_convention.theophoric: names invoke the sky and war-powers + a fused element: Munka- (eternal), -baatu (hero), Tomwi- (iron): e.g. Munka-baatu, names sworn under Maraksai.

religion._note: Deity-names are FUSED morphs of the Agrippan canon - single forms sitting between the Plains and Steppe theonym sets (Maraxus: Plains Maraksa / Steppe Marakhai -> fused Maraksai), never real gods. Karakan seeds/shifts Neutral or Chaotic; its stance follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment). The powers are met through the vision-quest and at the sacred cairn on the open horizon; there are no built temples.
religion.the_one: Eteruna (< Aeternus; fused of Plains Ateruna / Steppe Eterun) - the Eternal Sky-Above; reviled as the cold sky-tyrant when Chaotic, acknowledged as the distant maker when Neutral

sample_deity_renames.Maraxus: Maraksai (fused Maraksa/Marakhai) - the war-fire, the raider; Chaotic power
sample_deity_renames.Dementus: Tamendai (fused Tamawi/Tamendei) - the storm-sky; Chaotic power
sample_deity_renames.Realta: Reelta (fused Reawina/Erelta) - the mother, the life-giver; Neutral-honored
sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Gayanta (fused Kayanta/Gajan) - the enduring earth; Lawful power

worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: venerate the Chaotic powers (Maraksai the war-fire, Tamendai the storm, Lusantai the plunder-serpent), demonize the Lawful powers and the One (Eteruna)
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: all powers ambivalent - somewhat honored, somewhat feared; foreground the deeda-numu (ancestral dead), the animal-spirits and the powers of place

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the demonized set (the Lawful powers + the One, when Chaotic) take dread epithets: Tulrius -> Toralai the Cold-Sun; Orlandus -> Orlanga the Oath-Chain; Aeternus -> Eteruna the Sky-Tyrant.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: no built temples - the sacred cairn (tunawa) of [power] on a high horizon: 'the Tunawa of Maraksai', and the vision-hill.
religion.saints_pattern: the great khans and vision-seers who became sky- and animal-spirits; honored at the burial-scaffold and the sacred cairn.

holy_symbol_motifs.Maraksai: a red war-lance and horsetail-standard beneath a black storm
holy_symbol_motifs.Tamendai: forked lightning over the open grass
holy_symbol_motifs.Reelta: a life-giving rain over the green plain

banks_patterns.ships: landlocked riders name war-lances, standards and great horses: 'Storm-Runner', 'the Black Lance', 'Wind-Eater' (a famed steed)
banks_patterns.military_units: the war-societies and the decimal host: the [animal] society / the [khan] Tumen: 'the Wolf-society', 'the Storm Tumen'
banks_patterns.taverns: camps, not taverns: the council-tent / the [adjective] gerni: 'the Great Council-Tent', 'the Red Gerni'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: old burial-scaffolds, abandoned ordu-camps and spirit-haunted buttes: 'the Cairn of [khan]', 'the Ghost-Butte of [name]'
